## Issues

- The arbitrary-affine, lambda-tied `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` producer required by `PicRankOneOpen` is still absent.
- No general per-extension/per-class constructor for `SepClosedTranslatedDropData` exists; the base subtraction and presentation-family obligations remain explicit.
- A full project build was not run because the parallel integration lane owns protected Phase-3/4 files.
- The private-index retry over all paths authored by this lane produced zero diff, so no further authored commit was available. The shared index remains stale/concurrent: 5 paths, 7 insertions and 56 deletions at the final measurement, with no `index.lock`. The staged paths are inverse metadata snapshots plus concurrent `DivRankOneOpen.lean` and `DivSchemeRedesignRankOneChart.lean` changes; I did not commit them.

## Why I stopped

The requested universal translated-open cover is not complete. Closing it without the missing presentation producer would violate the anti-vacuity and ownership constraints.

## Next

The recovery/integration lane must supply the arbitrary-affine presentation/gluing producer and instantiate the per-`K`, per-`lambda` data package before consuming these bricks.
